title: feat(q1tot): among Q_* maps, cov1=12 iff vertex3=1
science: Second exact identity at |S|=1: inside Q_*={wt1=1 and adj2=1} (8 maps), cov1=12 iff vertex3=1 (N_v3=N_tot=N_both=4; the vertex3=0 half all sit at cov1=8). With #6516 this fully resolves cov1 into three levels {0, 8, 12} by two remaining bits.
